decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template sits close to the core agency hosting offer, costs little to maintain, and the firm's growth and hiring provide slack, so there is no shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
The responsive template was only mentioned on the website, but it is cheap to carry and fits the established offer, so in a growing firm with slack keeping it is the satisficing choice.
Premium support directly reinforces the firm's core promise of round-the-clock expert help for agencies and likely meets aspirations through recurring revenue.
The version management tool builds on the platform, has its own page, and serves the firm's strategy of tools that cut recurring operational work, so results are likely satisfactory.
The data processing contract tool is distant from the core business, but GDPR-driven demand in 2018 and the firm's slack let it carry this uncertain product for now.
